column5: ee boi caliba icikankala ukulenga epo taulatampa ukukula,pakweba ati balya ukapela ukukulilako bakalakonka ifyo wemwine ulefwaya.
column6: elyo umulumendo alemoneka naposhako saana amano,ifili mumbali talifimona na ukufimona.

column2: umulumendo naiminika icimbayambaya cakwe icakashika mumbali yamusebo.
column3: umulumendo wine cilya aiminika icimbayambaya afumanamo.
column4: elyo cilya alefuma acili alelolekesha mukati,cipalile kwati pali ifyo alaba pakufuma.
column5: limbi boi,nangula icimbayambaya cakwe ici cili icipya,teti akwanishe ukufumyako amenso.
column6: awe kwena icintu icipya calishupa ukufumya kumano kumona kwati ngawafumyako amano balakwibila.

column2: abakashana basano baleyangala mumensi ayamatipa,pali aba basano,babili nabekata kuntambo ii lebadonsa.
column3: cilemoneka aba bakashana balekwata inshita iyakusansamuka saana.
column4: saana boi pamenso pabo epalelondololafye fyonse,palifye apansansa nganshi.
column5: nomba abakashana nabo amenshi ubwingi basalapofye ayamatipa,tabalesakamana na ukulamba.
column6: akoni kekala pamusambo katemenwe boi,ndemona abene imitima epo shikele apapene.

column2: namayo umo naiminina mumbali yamusebo nashinta namunshiku,kuntanshi yakwe kuli na shitata uuli pancinga.
column3: uyuwine namayo alemoneka kwati pali ifyo aletontonkanyapo ifimushupile saana.
column4: ndemona nifyo,pantu emininefye eka nashinta namunshinku.
column5: limbi kuti caba ati pali ebo alelolela nomba balekokola ukwisa.
column6: elo amenso yalolelefye kuli shikulubantu uuli na incinga kwati eumulufyenye.

column2: shikulubantu umo naikala pali honda yakwe mumbali yamusebo.

column4: ee boi walungika,pakulolela ebo alelolela shikulu bantu uyu  alefokawilapo na fwaka.
column5: aba bantu balitemwa fwaka,kuluba nefyo basendamo pantu mucushi teti mufume nangu cimo.
column6: balishiba abene ifyo basendamo boi mwati kuti ulecita icintu icishilekupela nangu cimo.

column2: bashitata babili nabakwela pamulu wacipampa balecikakilila.
column3: cilemoneka aba bantu nibakanye kanye mumilimo ishi pantu balemoneka tabakwete na umwenso pamulu palya bali.
column4: ndemona kale batamba balibelela,incito yonse ngawaibelela boi ilamoneka iyaanguka saana.
column5: shitata uuli pamulu alemoneka kwati emwine wancito ii elyo uyu shitata kunshi alemoneka kwati alemwafwakofye.
column6: ee boi incito ii nangula wingaba kanye kanye teti uibombe weka kanshi ifwaika umuntu uwakukwikatishako.

column2: cinkupiti wabantu ali mucisankano,aba bantu baleshita ifintu ifyapusana pusana.
column3: ici cisankano cilemoneka kwati cilasenda saana abantu abengi,pantu abali uku kuncende nabafulisha nganshi.
column4: ee boi elo kulemoneka kwati ifintu fyalicipa saana kuncende iyi icilengele abantu ukufula.
column5: ee boi kuti caba cishinka ico pantu abantu balitemwa saana ifyacipa.
column6: ee boi kaili ifyacipa filafwilishako ukusunga indala pantu ukalashita ifintu ifingi pamutengo uunono.

column2: banamayo babili nabekala kunuma yacimbayambaya balelya icakulya.
column3: cilemoneka aba banamayo baciba pancito nomba insala yabekata ati natulyeko icakulya.
column4: efyo cilepala boi,elyo balemoneka ati balabombesha saana aba bantu,imimonekele yabo ilelondolola fyonse.
column5: elyo boi cilepala kwati aba bantu nibalya abapita mumatuka baleshitisha imikate.
column6: ee kuti caba cishinka ico,pantu nombona ecakulya balelya nokulya,bafwile balomfwa bwino saana ici cakulya.

column2: ibumba lyabantu abampendwa nabatantama,uuli pantanshi mukalamba elyo bonse kunuma baice.
column3: cilemoneka kwati uyu mulumendo umukalamba aleyangasha aba baice.
column4: ee boi elyo abaice nabomfwa bwino saana balemukonkafye konse uko aya.
column5: elyo cilemoneka aba baice bekala muncende imoine,ecilengele bakolongane ubusaka saana.
column6: ee boi,elyo abaice balomfwa bwino saana ukwangala kwakweba ati bali na umukalamba,pantu umukalamba akulabafunda amangalo ayapusa pusana.

column2: shitata nakwela pamulu we horse alelisbutusha,kunuma yakwe kuli noulekoma kwilinga.
column3: elyo i horse line ili akwelelepo lilemoneka kwati lili mukuponena panshi.
column4: ee bou efyo cilemoneka,elyo uyu muntu ukwelele pamulu alemoneka kwati alepona nalyena.
column5: awe kwena eco aya mangalo yatinisha,pantu ifingacitika fingi saana.
column6: ndemona balasambilila ifyakucita icinama ukwelelepo nkacapona,afwile palya ali tasakamene nakusakamana.

column2: umukashana umo alikuntashi naikata necakupundilamo aleimba.

column4: ee boi elyo alemoneka kwati aleumfwa bwino saana ukwimbila aba bantu.
column5: ee boi umukashana alemoneka alomfwa bwino ifyo acita ecilengele nabantu ukufitemwa.
column6: ndemona ili italanta lyakwe lilamuletela saana indalama pantu ndesubila kwingi saana uko bamwita ukuya mukwimba.

column2: umukashana umo ali muchibansa aleteyaubwangalo bwa tennis.
column3: ubu bwangalo bumoneka kwati bufwaika abantu abayangukilwa.
column4: ee boi cishinka ico kaili mwaliba ukubutauka mubwangalo umu,kanshi ngawalifinina teti ukwanishe.
column5: elyo uyu wine mukashana alemonekafye uwatekanya talemonekapo nokuti ali na umwenso.
column6: ee boi umwenso teti akwate kaili afwile aliipekanya umupwilapo ilyo ubwangalo ubu bwali tabulafika.

column2: shitata umo naikala pacilibe icikulu,kunuma yakwe kulemoneka na ifimuti ifingi saana.
column3: cilemoneka shikulu bantu uyu ele kuli ii ncende ukuti akwateko inshita ekafye ukwabula icongo.
column4: ee boi limo icongo cilacilamo mumayanda,kanshi cikankala saana ukukwatako inshita weka.
column5: ee boi kaili inshita uli weka ilalengako walabako kufintu fimo ifyamucalo.
column6: elyo shitata uyu ilibwe ekalepo lilemoneka ubusaka saana ilikulu bwino bwino.

column2: bashi tata babili nabasansamuka ngashi,umo nabamupapa namunuma.
column3: aba baume balemoneka kwati nibalya abaume abopana beka beka.
column4: ee boi pantu abaumefye bwino bwino tabangala umusango uyu.
column5: elo balemoneka kwati baciya mukushita ifintu ifyalekana lekana.
column6: ew boi,apa teti wishibe ngacakuti umulume niwisa nangula uukashi niwisa.

column2: shitata umo nasekelela nganshi naikata na injuka kuminwe.
column3: uyu shikulu bantu alemoneka kwati nibalya abapitana balelangisha abantu ifyo bengacita na injuka.
column4: ee boi walungika,elyo ababene bantu balaba abasalapukisha saana kuluba nefyo bacita injuka shabo shine ishi.
column5: ee boi kutiwapapa pantu kuli ifwe fwebashafishiba fimoneka kwati buloshi.
column6: teti twishibe limbi balabikamo na ubuloshi,pantu ifintu bacita fimo filacilamo.
